**US-China trade deal update** — China has committed to purchasing at least $17 billion in US agricultural products annually through 2028, per a White House fact sheet.

**Sen. Bill Cassidy loses GOP primary** — The Louisiana Republican who voted to convict Trump in his second impeachment lost his reelection bid, with Trump-backed Rep. Julia Letlow advancing to a June 27 runoff.

**Italy vehicle attack** — A driver rammed pedestrians in Modena, Italy, injuring at least 8 people, 4 critically. Suspect was arrested.
